title: Steering Wheel Gadget Update
content: I added a little hook flange to the back of my steering wheel attachment. It's a small improvement, but it keeps the sketch easel from slipping off the steering wheel.The new hook is the little dark piece of wood that's held with a screw at the middle of the curving span.I added it because our new car has a fatter steering wheel, and the whole thing would tend to slip off otherwise.For those unfamiliar with this steering-wheel attachment,here's a YouTube videothat shows how it's made and what it does.And if you're new to the whole idea of the homemade Sketch Easel,here's a Gumroad tutorial videothat takes you through the build process.
